components.name: Diary navigation
components.description: Normal underlined links with visible hover and keyboard focus.

narrative.overview: This records the implemented local-MVP baseline, not a separately approved visual rebrand. Actual diary prose is the content; interface copy stays outside it. The surface is a readable document rather than a simulation dashboard.
dos: Do keep UTC visible in the frame and individual timestamps.
Do render actual published text unchanged and escaped.
Do keep readable measures, visible link affordances, and keyboard access.
donts: Don't use demonstration text to fill a quiet live diary.
Don't introduce motion or reader controls that influence the life without a new product decision.
